frequency_rule: Remove section-heading lines; alphabetic tokens; exclude spaCy stop words; lower-case lemmas. Denominator = retained tokens. Names retained.
working_rule: Distinct pageids linked by at least one own site match; related-only pages excluded.
collocation_rule: Adjacent alphabetic surface-token pairs within sentences/documents; lower-case; punctuation interrupts adjacency; heading lines removed. PMI marginals are left/right positions in eligible pair slots; minimum pair count 5 and document count 3. Both-stop-word and one-stop-word pairs hidden only after counting.

teaching_tables.articles: Three selected complete articles; original text retained separately from heading-stripped text.
teaching_tables.collocations: Curated union of top-frequency pairs, top-PMI pairs and lecture candidates. Not an exhaustive pair table.
teaching_tables.concordances: Up to four retrieved sentences per candidate pair, plus the three selected-article music passages used on the lecture slide; not exhaustive occurrences. query_kind distinguishes surface forms from adjacent pairs.
teaching_tables.reviews: Three intentionally selected short museum reviews for interpretation; not a representative sample.
teaching_tables.review_ids: Teaching identifiers derived from text hashes, not source-provided unique review IDs.
teaching_tables.review_scores: All 468 museum reviews (five London venues, 2023-24) with their star rating, for a whole-sample sentiment check. Wording unchanged; not a representative visitor sample.
teaching_tables.corpus: All articles in the current full Wikipedia corpus, including related-only pages; one row per doc_id. Primary category uses Museum, then Theatre, then Music venue priority; borough is the first listed borough. Text has section-heading lines removed. Tokenisation and word selection happen in the lecture, not in this file.

lecture_corpus.scope: All rows in wikipedia_corpus_full.jsonl, including related-only pages; distinct doc_id values, not venue records.
lecture_corpus.category_rule: Museums and public galleries -> Museum; otherwise Theatre -> Theatre; otherwise Music venue. A single teaching label, not a claim that venues have only one function.
lecture_corpus.borough_rule: First semicolon-separated source borough; not a unique location for multi-site articles.
lecture_corpus.counting_rule: spaCy nlp.tokenizer; alphabetic tokens only; exclude spaCy stop words; lowercase surface forms (token.lower_), not lemmas. Denominator for category percentages: all retained word occurrences in that category.
lecture_corpus.source_attribution: Wikipedia contributors, CC BY-SA 4.0; doc_id = wiki_{pageid}. Article URLs, revisions, venue links and full attribution are retained in the source JSONL. w09_articles.csv carries them for the three workshop articles.

prepared_summary_cohort.rule: Distinct pageids linked by at least one own site match; related-only pages excluded.
prepared_summary_cohort.note: Supplementary prepared summaries use the own-match subset, unlike the full lecture corpus. Top-level working_documents and frequency_rule describe these prepared examples, not the lecture surface-word counts.

sentiment_reviews.rule: All source museum reviews with an integer star rating from 1 to 5; original text, case and punctuation retained. VADER compound scores are calculated live; no precomputed sentiment score column.
